headlines.title: Inside Iowa’s critical midterm Senate race
headlines.description: NBC Nightly News anchor Tom Llamas interviews Democrat Josh Turek, Republican Ashley Hinson and voters in Iowa.

headlines.title: Trump hopes to flatter Putin into negotiating on Ukraine, experts say
headlines.description: A Trump diplomat called Putin “a humanitarian,” another in a recent flurry of overtures to the Russian leader. But it’s unclear whether blandishments will entice him to strike a deal.

headlines.title: Pope Leo needs no further cancer treatment after lung surgery
headlines.description: Tests show the cancer was confined to the portion of the pope’s right lung that was removed, his doctors say. NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports.

headlines.title: Teacher who survived Bend shooting tried to close door, ‘but the shooter was already there’
headlines.description: Becky Drury was shot and seriously wounded by the gunman, who killed three children and another teacher at Silver Rail Elementary School in Oregon.

headlines.title: Russians locked out of bank accounts and apartments as Ukraine hits data centers
headlines.description: The strikes that took place over several days earlier this month were the first publicized attacks on Russian data centers.

headlines.title: Ohio gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton condemns ad featuring her estranged mother
headlines.description: Ohio Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton is condemning a new ad circulating online featuring her estranged mother. NBC News national politics reporter Henry Gomez discusses how close the race between Acton and Republican candidate Vivek Ramaswamy has become in the campaign's final two weeks.

headlines.title: Mom whose son was found alive in morgue speaks out: ‘It’s an unexplainable feeling’
headlines.description: Alexus Fiordilino said she thought her 18-month-old son, Vincent, was still breathing when she gave him a final hug, but the emergency room doctor insisted he was gone.
